_about: Base 21 builds on Base 20; Gripper 25 unchanged. Four-post retaining cap, reduced supports, overhead direct drive.

params.name: scale_factor

params.name: min_screw_rim
params.label: Minimum pinion screw rim
params.doc: Minimum solid wall outside the full-size 6.4 mm countersink and inside the pinion tooth root. Governs minimum scale.

params.name: actual_m3_head_d
params.label: Actual M3 Head D

params.name: actual_m3_head_h

params.name: actual_m2_head_d

params.name: actual_m2_head_h

params.name: min_lattice_web
params.label: Min Lattice Web
params.doc: Adopted minimum ventral-plan ligament for fine resin prototype; not an FDM or strength rating.

params.name: min_gear_module
params.label: Min Gear Module
params.doc: Minimum involute module used in candidate selection.

params.name: min_base_rim
params.label: Min Base Rim
params.doc: Base material beyond the pinion addendum.

params.name: cap_pillar_x
params.label: Cap Pillar X
params.doc: Actual cap-post half-spacing; moved behind the larger stock-horn pinion.

params.name: pillar_motion_clear
params.label: Pillar Motion Clear
params.doc: Required separation of rear cap pillars from pinion teeth.

params.name: horn_screw_length
params.label: Horn Screw Length
params.doc: Candidate overall countersunk M3 length: CAD clears case, 2.5 mm horn engagement. Confirm purchased horn and screw head.

params.name: case_screw_length
params.label: Case Screw Length
params.doc: Candidate M2 length under head: 4 mm modeled case engagement, same unmeasured depth assumption as large source.

params.name: cap_screw_length
params.label: Cap Screw Length
params.doc: Candidate overall countersunk M3 length: 7 mm into pillar, 0.3 mm modeled pilot-bottom clearance.

params.name: actual_m3_shank_d
params.label: Actual M3 Shank D
params.doc: M3 unthreaded clearance probe diameter.

params.name: actual_m2_shank_d
params.label: Actual M2 Shank D
params.doc: M2 unthreaded clearance probe diameter.

params.name: beak_stretch
params.label: Beak length
params.doc: How many times the photo's beak (black dot to point) is stretched along the finger. 1.70 makes dot to point a third of the finger (Gen 15).

params.name: outer_lean_deg
params.label: Outer edge lean at the dot
params.doc: The outer edge leaves the black dot this far outboard of the finger axis. 2.5: 15, 1.19's wide beak (2.4: 0).

params.name: outer_start_handle
params.label: Outer edge: fullness behind
params.doc: Bezier handle at the dot end of the outer edge, as a fraction of dot-to-point. Longer keeps the beak full further out. 2.5: 0.50, 1.19's (2.4: 0.30).

params.name: outer_end_handle
params.label: Outer edge: fullness at the point
params.doc: Bezier handle at the point end of the outer edge. Longer rounds in later, giving a blunter nose. 2.5: 0.25, 1.19's (2.4: 0.30).

params.name: outer_bow
params.label: Outer edge bow
params.doc: How far the outer edge bows outboard of the straight dot-to-point line, as a fraction of its length. 2.5: 0.20, 1.19's (2.4: 0.04).

params.name: jaw_open_power
params.label: Jaw convergence (opening shape)
params.doc: Closed, each jaw edge sits H (d/D)^p off the centreline, d mm behind the point. Below 1 the gap opens fastest right at the point (sharper convergence angle); 1 is a straight triangle; above 1 the jaws run nearly parallel near the tip.

params.name: knob_swell
params.label: Inner bump-out height
params.doc: How far the two rounded swells on the inner edge, mid-shank, stand proud of the ramp.

params.name: knob1_halfwidth
params.label: Bump 1 half-width (near the head)
params.doc: Half-width along the edge of the first swell's cos^2 window. Wider is rounder.

params.name: knob2_halfwidth
params.label: Bump 2 half-width (near the dot)
params.doc: Half-width of the second swell, just behind the black dot. Its crest also sets where the closed jaw triangle starts.

params.name: knob_ramp_smooth
params.label: Bump ramp smoothing
params.doc: Gaussian smoothing of the inner-edge ramp under the swells, so its own bends put no corners at their feet.

params.name: outline_smooth
params.label: Outline smoothing
params.doc: Gaussian smoothing along the traced photo contour (Gen 9 / Gen 16 roundness).

params.name: dot_join_smooth
params.label: Smoothing at the dot joins
params.doc: Where the generated beak meets the traced shank, both edges are smoothed with this sigma.

params.name: dot_join_span
params.label: Dot join span
params.doc: Half-length of arc smoothed either side of each dot join.

params.name: hook_depth
params.label: Base hook depth
params.doc: Scales the base J-hook's bowl and toe away from the line between its two ends (1 = Gen 9's hook). The handle's foot is trimmed to whatever notch this makes.

params.name: top_notch_u
params.label: Top hook position
params.doc: 2.6: u (along the straight outer edge from the rail origin) of the top hook's notch floor. The edge runs straight up to it, the base J-hook mirrored end for end curls round there, its notch open toward the base, and the handle spans floor to floor (base floor u -11.4), so this sets the handle's length. 54: where 1.20's edge started going out again (2.5: top_hook_mirror_u 8.5, floor 28.4).

params.name: top_step_back
params.label: Top step: back dips by
params.doc: 2.6: from the top hook's crest (6.6 mm out) the outer edge fills on to the beak's outer edge where it is back up to the crest's height less this. 0 = a level shoulder, one jump out (Jake: no double indent); larger meets the edge sooner, lower down the blade-root curve, and dips behind the crest.

params.name: slot_count
params.label: Beak slot count
params.doc: How many slanted slots run up the beak (the photo shows six on the upper finger).

params.name: groove_pitch
params.label: Groove pitch
params.doc: Spacing of the inner-edge grooves. Off-pitch values can land a groove wall on the tip-zone cut; the render reports it.

params.name: groove_width
params.label: Groove width
params.doc: Width of each groove across its station.

params.name: groove_depth
params.label: Groove depth
params.doc: Depth of each groove, measured in from the finished edge. 0 = no grooves.

params.name: groove_stop
params.label: Grooves stop short of the point
params.doc: Arc length from the point with no grooves.

params.name: groove_min_width
params.label: Grooves stop where the beak is narrower than
params.doc: Below this width across the beak a groove would leave a pinhole; the row stops there.

params.name: plate
params.label: Finger thickness
params.doc: The finger's thickness along Y (the 12 mm side), centred on the hand plane.

params.name: tip_thick
params.label: Thickness at the point (taper)
params.doc: At or above the finger thickness there is no taper (2.3). Below it, the dorsal (+Y) face slopes down from the black dot to this at the point and the ventral face stays flat (1.18's print-flat taper; 1.18 used 2.4). 2.5: 2.4, 1.18's flat-bottom taper (2.4: 12, none).

params.name: taper_power
params.label: Taper curve
params.doc: Thickness drops as f^power from the taper start to the point: 1 is a straight wedge, 2 Gen 16's parabola (full near the dot, steep at the point).

params.name: taper_start
params.label: Taper start past the dot
params.doc: Where along the finger the taper begins, relative to the black dot (negative = toward the base).

params.name: tip_r
params.label: Point rounding
params.doc: Plan-view radius of the point. The closed fingers touch here.

params.name: tip_zone
params.label: Point rounding zone
params.doc: tip_r applies within this many mm of the point; elsewhere edge_round. Keep it off the groove pitch (at 6 a groove wall sat on the cut: non-manifold).

params.name: edge_round
params.label: Convex corner rounding
params.doc: Radius on every convex corner of the plan outline (photo blur to smooth edges).

params.name: fillet_r
params.label: Concave fillet
params.doc: Radius in every concave corner of the plan outline (the shoulder).

params.name: min_hole
params.label: Smallest honeycomb hole
params.doc: Blurred small holes are read no smaller than this.

params.name: hole_scale
params.label: Honeycomb hole size
params.doc: Multiplies every traced honeycomb hole's diameter.

params.name: dot_scale
params.label: Black dot size
params.doc: Multiplies the black dot's traced 3.4 mm diameter.

params.name: slot_len
params.label: Beak slot length
params.doc: Length of each slanted beak slot.

params.name: slot_width
params.label: Beak slot width
params.doc: Width of each beak slot (round ends).

params.name: last_slot_scale
params.label: Last slot size
params.doc: The slot nearest the point is this fraction of the others.

params.name: slot_angle_deg
params.label: Slot slant (photo)
params.doc: Slot direction in the photo's image degrees (a forward slash, ~35 deg off the row).

params.name: groove_wall
params.label: Wall between grooves and holes
params.doc: Least wall kept between a groove and any hole, so no groove opens into one.

params.name: tip_gap
params.label: Closed gap at the points
params.doc: Closed, the points are this far apart (0 = touching; negative = preload/overlap).

params.name: fit
params.label: Fit clearance (per side)
params.doc: Clearance per side between handle and finger: the plate against the outer edge and each foot in its hook's notch.

params.name: slide_t
params.label: Plate thickness
params.doc: The black handle plate's thickness (outboard of the finger).

params.name: handle_over
params.label: Handle past each finger face
params.doc: Handle 7 / Base 4: the plate stands this far past the finger on each face (dorsal and ventral), so it is plate + 2x this tall across the finger: 0 = the finger's 12 mm (Base 3: 1.5, 15 mm).

params.name: span_over
params.label: Plate run past each notch floor
params.doc: 2.5: the plate spans the finger's outer edge from the base hook's notch floor to the top hook's, plus this at each end; the finger outline grown by fit then trims both ends into feet that fill the two notches. Its length follows the hooks (top_hook_mirror_u).

params.name: slide_w0
params.label: Plate stand-off from the finger
params.doc: The plate's inboard face sits this far outboard of the rail line; the finger's outer edge reaches +0.17 at most.

params.name: plate_corner_r
params.label: Plate corner radius
params.doc: Base 7: rounding on the plate's two ends, in plan (seen from the dorsal side), so every wall stays vertical as it prints. Under half slide_t. (Base 4: 3, rounded edge-on, which overhung at the bed.)

params.name: strap_width
params.label: Strap (webbing) width
params.doc: Nominal loop webbing width (not measured; straps are not modelled).

params.name: strap_thick
params.label: Strap thickness
params.doc: Nominal webbing thickness; documented only (the slot width below sets the opening).

params.name: strap_slot_clearance
params.label: Slot length over strap width
params.doc: The strap tunnel is the strap width plus this long (along the finger).

params.name: strap_slot_width
params.label: Strap slot width
params.doc: 3.3: the tunnel's gap (outboard of the plate) that the webbing runs through, across the finger from one face to the other. 2.5 (3.2: a 3.5 mm slot through the plate either side of the finger).

params.name: strap_slots
params.label: Strap-loop slots
params.doc: Base 8: how many strap-loop slots each handle-gear has, side by side along the handle plate, each a tunnel right through the part (y) under the strap boss, so it prints as a straight hole with no bridge. One loop per slot wraps the boss and the digit lying on it. 1 = Base 7's single tunnel.

params.name: strap_rib
params.label: Rib between slots
params.doc: Base 8: the solid rib of boss between neighbouring strap-loop slots, along the finger. The slots and ribs together are centred on the plate.

params.name: slots_shift
params.label: Slots shift toward the top hook
params.doc: Base 8: moves the strap-loop slots (and their boss) this far along the plate toward the top hook from centred. At 3 the lower slot's ventral mouth clears the base plate at every swing with 20 mm webbing (centred, the base sits in it); check_geometry.py checks it.

params.name: slot_wall
params.label: Tunnel wall
params.doc: 3.3: the strap boss's outer wall over the tunnel (the digit lies on it) and its end walls, along the finger.

params.name: slot_corner_r
params.label: Slot corner radius
params.doc: Rounding on the tunnel's and the boss's corners (less than half the tunnel gap).

params.name: strap_clear
params.label: Strap keep-out round the slots
params.doc: 3.2/3.3: nothing but the handle itself may come within this of either tunnel mouth (the webbing leaves the tunnel there, past each face of the plate), at any swing. check_geometry.py checks it.

groups.name: Handle tail, gear hub and pivot post (Base 7: one print each)

params.name: tail_gap
params.label: Tail gap off the finger
params.doc: 3.3: the handle's tail is a band that follows the finger's outline this far off it: up the outer edge, over the base hook's prong, round the hook and under the finger. Base 4: inside the gear hub the finger's pocket is cut fit off it, so tail and hub are one solid.

params.name: tail_top_u
params.label: Tail top (along the edge)
params.doc: 3.3: the band starts on the plate this far along the outer edge (rail u; the base hook's prong tip is at -9.2), so it covers the prong.

params.name: tail_reach
params.label: Tail reach under the finger
params.doc: 3.3: the band runs on under the finger's base until it is this far inboard of the outer edge line (rail w). Its end is the key the gear's cradle drives. Base 4: it fuses into the gear hub (no key).

params.name: hub_r
params.label: Gear hub radius
params.doc: Base 4: each side gear's hub disc round its pivot. The handle's tail runs into it and the finger's base sits in a pocket cut fit off the finger, on the web (3.3: a separate cradle with a key notch). Base 20/Gripper 25: reduced direct-contact pivot; no handle interface.

params.name: loop_r
params.label: Finger loop radius
params.doc: Base 15 / Gripper 22: the ring round the pivot post that replaces Gripper 21's base J-hook, concentric with the handle-gear's hub and sitting in its pocket on the web; its bore is base_clear off the post, like the web's. Base 20/Gripper 25: reduced direct-contact pivot; no handle interface.

params.name: hub_top
params.label: Hub top
params.doc: The hub is cut off this far above the pivot (finger-frame z). Base 7: 14 (= hub_r), a whole disc, so the web is a full ring round the pivot post's bore and the post bears all the way round (Base 4: 0 cut the hub at the pivot, which left half the bore open under the finger). Base 20/Gripper 25: reduced direct-contact pivot; no handle interface.

params.name: web_t
params.label: Gear web
params.doc: The floor of each handle-gear under the finger (it sits fit above it); the finger drops in from the dorsal side and rests on it, so it is also the stop. Base 7: it is the print's bed face, and the handle plate, strap boss, tail, hub and teeth all run down to it, so the whole handle-gear is one flat-bottomed extrusion (handle plate+fit+web_t = 15.2 mm tall).

params.name: post_d
params.label: Pivot post
params.doc: Base 7: the post that stands up out of the base at each pivot; its handle-gear turns on it through a bore in its web. Base 15: it runs on up through the finger's loop into a socket in the top plate (Base 7-14: it stopped fit under the finger). Base 20/Gripper 25: reduced direct-contact pivot; no handle interface.

params.name: screw_clear_d
params.label: M3 clearance hole
params.doc: Every M3 through-hole in a printed part (the motor flange and front ring screws).

params.name: stack_gap
params.label: Gap between stacked parts
params.doc: Running clearance between each gear (and the pinion) and the base plate.

groups.name: Gears (Base 7: full height, in the finger plane)

params.name: pivot_spacing
params.label: Pivot spacing (finger bases apart)
params.doc: Base 12: the distance between the two fingers' pivots, the driving dimension (Base 11 derived it from the traced outline: 54.5). Each finger is toed in about its pivot just far enough that the closed points still meet on the centreline, so a wider spacing gives a sharper converging angle and more gap at the base. The side gears' pitch radius is half of it, so the gears, pinion and base all follow. 62.7 = Base 11 + 15%.

params.name: gear_teeth
params.label: Teeth (full circle)
params.doc: Teeth on the full gear circle. The pitch radius is fixed to the pivot half-spacing (pivot_spacing/2), so this sets the module: 34 = module 1.60.

params.name: gear_pressure_deg
params.label: Pressure angle
params.doc: Involute pressure angle.

params.name: gear_backlash
params.label: Backlash
params.doc: Tooth thickness taken off at the pitch circle, so the printed pair runs free.

params.name: gear_extra
params.label: Extra teeth past the swing
params.doc: 3.3: each gear carries teeth only where its mates meet it over the 0-30 deg swing, plus this many tooth pitches at each end. The left one must stay clear of the pinion.

params.name: pinion_teeth
params.label: Pinion teeth
params.doc: Base 12: 16 (Base 11: 34). The pinion on the STS3215's horn drives the right handle-gear; 16 against the side gears' 34 is 2.1:1, so the servo turns 64 deg for 30 deg of finger swing (more grip torque, finer encoder reading). 16 is the fewest that keeps the horn's countersunk M3 heads 1 mm inside the tooth roots.

params.name: pinion_mesh_deg
params.label: Pinion position round the right gear
params.doc: Base 12: where the pinion meets the right handle-gear, measured down from the pivots' line at the right pivot (Base 11: on the centreline, 60 deg at 34 teeth). Under ~53 deg the pinion reaches into the left gear's teeth; higher means a shorter base.

params.name: gear_bolt_phase_deg
params.label: Gear-to-flange bolt angle
params.doc: STS3215 CAD stock horn four-hole phase at neutral, corrected from the large source RS00-era 30 degrees. Servo zero/assembly phase must follow this mounting orientation.

params.name: gear_bolt_head_d
params.label: Pinion screw countersink
params.doc: Base 7: the pinion's 3 screws are M3 countersunk (DIN 7991, 6 mm head, 90 deg). Each hole opens this wide at the pinion's top face, which is its bed face, and narrows at 45 deg to the M3 clearance hole, so the head seats on a cone that prints without support (Base 4: a flat-floored counterbore, a 1 mm ledge hanging in the air printed this way up).

params.name: gear_bolt_head_h
params.label: Pinion screw recess
params.doc: Shallow 0.3 mm pinion screw head recess; countersink remains 6.4 mm diameter for real M3 heads. Removes the large source unnecessary 5 mm deep access wells.

params.name: base_t
params.label: Base plate thickness
params.doc: The black plate under both gears and the pinion; the motor bolts under it.

params.name: base_r
params.label: Base radius round the motor
params.doc: Base 12: 17.5 (Base 11: 29). The plate is the hull of a disc this big round the pinion's axis, one round each pivot post and the two pillars. Just past the 16-tooth pinion's tip circle (16.6).

params.name: bush_r
params.label: Base radius round each post
params.doc: The base's disc round each pivot post. Base 20/Gripper 25: reduced direct-contact pivot; no handle interface.

params.name: base_clear
params.label: Post clearance (per side)
params.doc: Between each pivot post and its bore in the handle-gear, and the pinion spigot and its hole in the plate.

params.name: motor_screw_head_d
params.label: Base screw countersink
params.doc: Base 7: the base's 3 motor screws are the same M3 countersunk; the hole opens this wide at the plate's top and narrows at 45 deg (one screw type for the whole gripper).

params.name: motor_screw_head_h
params.label: Base screw recess
params.doc: How far the heads' tops sit under the plate's top face (the pinion turns over them). At 0.3 an M3x10 countersunk screw engages the front ring 4.3 mm.

params.name: motor_sts
params.label: Motor: 0 RS00, 1 STS3215
params.doc: Base 14 (as Base 12) is the Feetech STS3215 (the SO-101 servo) only: its horn takes the pinion, its case screws to the base, and the base's wrist tab takes the reBot wrist mount. 0 (RobStride RS00, Base 10/11) is not carried: its 50 mm screw ring does not fit the compact base.

params.name: motor_d
params.label: Body diameter
params.doc: RS00 (the B601-RS gripper motor): 57 mm. Source: RobStride RS00 drawing (Seeed 100083284) and RS00.step. 14 N m peak, 5 N m rated, 315 rpm no-load at 48 V, CAN.

params.name: motor_len
params.label: Body length
params.doc: 51 +-1 mm, front face to back (drawing); the output boss adds motor_boss_h.

params.name: motor_boss_d
params.label: Output boss diameter
params.doc: The turning output boss on the front face. The pinion's spigot sits on it.

params.name: motor_boss_h
params.label: Output boss height
params.doc: How far the output boss stands proud of the front face (drawing: 1).

params.name: motor_out_pcd
params.label: Output flange bolt circle
params.doc: 6 x M3, 5 deep, on 27 +-0.1 (drawing). 3.3: the pinion bolts here.

params.name: motor_out_holes
params.label: Output flange bolts
params.doc: Number of M3 holes on the output flange.

params.name: motor_out_depth
params.label: Output thread depth
params.doc: Thread depth of those holes.

params.name: motor_out_screws
params.label: Pinion bolts used
params.doc: Base 4: how many of the output flange's motor_out_holes the pinion is bolted through, evenly spaced (3 = every other hole, 120 deg apart; Base 3: all 6). Must divide motor_out_holes. 3 x M3 at 13.5 mm carry the RS00's 14 N m peak with margin (~350 N shear each).

params.name: motor_front_pcd
params.label: Front ring bolt circle
params.doc: 6 x M3 on 50 +-0.1 on the fixed front ring (drawing). The base plate bolts here.

params.name: motor_front_holes
params.label: Front ring bolts
params.doc: Number of M3 holes on the front ring.

params.name: motor_front_phase_deg
params.label: Front ring bolt angle
params.doc: Angle of the first front-ring hole from +x (drawing: 30 deg off the vertical centreline).

params.name: motor_front_depth
params.label: Front thread depth
params.doc: Thread depth on the front ring (the drawing does not give it for this ring; 5 assumed like the output).

params.name: motor_front_screws
params.label: Base-to-motor bolts used
params.doc: Base 4: how many of the front ring's motor_front_holes hold the base plate on, evenly spaced (3 = every other hole; Base 3: all 6). The two dowels still locate it. Must divide motor_front_holes.

params.name: motor_dowel_d
params.label: Dowel hole diameter
params.doc: 2 x 3 (+0.02/+0.04), 5 deep, on the front ring circle (drawing).

params.name: motor_dowel_depth
params.label: Dowel hole depth
params.doc: Depth of the two dowel holes.

params.name: motor_dowel_phase_deg
params.label: Dowel angle
params.doc: Angle of the first dowel from +x (drawing: 15 deg); the second is assumed opposite it.

params.name: motor_back_pcd
params.label: Back face bolt circle
params.doc: 4 x M3, 4 deep, on 38 +-0.1 on the back face (drawing). 3.2: the wrist mount (the base plate has no wrist tab).

params.name: motor_back_holes
params.label: Back face bolts
params.doc: Number of holes on the back face.

params.name: motor_back_depth
params.label: Back thread depth
params.doc: Thread depth on the back face.

params.name: motor_back_phase_deg
params.label: Back face bolt angle
params.doc: Angle of the first back-face hole (drawing: 45).

params.name: motor_conn_deg
params.label: Connector direction
params.doc: Base 10: the RS00's two cable connectors (CAN + 48 V in, and out for the daisy chain) stand out of its body side by side-opposite at its back end. Measured from Seeed's motor_7 mesh. This is their direction from +x in the plan (0: across, +-x). The base takes 3 of the front ring's 6 screws, so the motor can be clocked in 60 deg steps; set this to where they really point. The wrist bracket must clear them.

params.name: motor_conn_r
params.label: Connector reach
params.doc: Base 10: how far the connectors reach from the motor axis (Seeed motor_7 mesh: 41.5).

params.name: motor_conn_w
params.label: Connector width
params.doc: Base 10: the connectors' width across (Seeed mesh: 25.8).

params.name: motor_conn_len
params.label: Connector length
params.doc: Base 10: how far the connectors run along the body from its back face (Seeed mesh: ~13).

params.name: sts_body_deg
params.label: Servo body direction
params.doc: Real servo body runs left under the gearbox; avoids its full-size label hump cutting the right pivot support.

params.name: sts_near
params.label: Axis to the near end
params.doc: From the output axis to the body's near end (the output end). STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_len
params.label: Body length
params.doc: The case's long side. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_w
params.label: Body width
params.doc: The case across. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_depth
params.label: Body depth
params.doc: From the mounting face (the two rails the case screws are in) to the back face. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_face_drop
params.label: Output face below the rails
params.doc: The output end of the case's front face sits this far below the rails, so the base bears only on the rails. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_rail_u
params.label: Rails start
params.doc: Where the rails begin, from the output axis toward the far end. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_hump_u
params.label: Hump start
params.doc: The raised middle of the front face (the label hump) begins here from the axis. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_hump_w
params.label: Hump width
params.doc: The hump's width across the case (the rails are either side of it). STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_hump_h
params.label: Hump height
params.doc: How far the hump stands above the rails. The base has a window over it, cut straight through, so it prints with no bridge. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_boss_d
params.label: Output boss
params.doc: The output spline boss under the horn. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_horn_d
params.label: Horn diameter
params.doc: The stock round horn on the output (top horn, the one with the M3 centre screw). STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_horn_y0
params.label: Horn underside
params.doc: The horn's underside above the rails. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_horn_top
params.label: Horn top
params.doc: The horn's top face above the rails: the pinion's spigot sits on it. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_horn_pcd
params.label: Horn screw circle
params.doc: The horn's 4 holes (2.5 mm, M3 cut into the horn) on this circle. SO-101 assembly: 4 M3x6 into the horn. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_horn_holes
params.label: Horn holes
params.doc: The horn's screw holes; the pinion uses all of them. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_horn_screw_head_d
params.label: Horn centre screw head
params.doc: The horn's centre M3 screw (SO-101: M3x6) stands proud of the horn; the pinion's spigot has a recess this wide for its head.

params.name: sts_horn_screw_head_h
params.label: Horn centre screw head height
params.doc: How far the centre screw's head stands above the horn (the STEP: 1.5). The recess is 0.3 deeper.

params.name: sts_screw_u0
params.label: Near case screws
params.doc: The front face's two near M2 holes, from the axis toward the far end. SO-101 assembly: M2x6 into the case. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_screw_u1
params.label: Far case screws
params.doc: The two far M2 holes, from the axis. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_screw_w
params.label: Case screw spacing
params.doc: Across the case between each pair of M2 holes. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_screw_d
params.label: M2 clearance
params.doc: The base's clearance holes for the 4 M2 case screws.

params.name: sts_screw_head_d
params.label: M2 head recess
params.doc: The recess round each M2 head in the base's top face (M2 pan head 3.8): the heads sit below the handle-gears.

params.name: sts_screw_head_h
params.label: M2 head recess depth
params.doc: The recess depth; the screw is M2x8 (base_t - this + 4 mm into the case).

params.name: sts_idler_d
params.label: Idler horn diameter
params.doc: The free horn on the back face (no screw; SO-101 fits both horns). STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_idler_h
params.label: Idler horn height
params.doc: How far the idler horn stands off the back face (with its boss, 2.4). STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_conn_u0
params.label: Connectors from
params.doc: The two 3-pin bus connectors on the back face run from here (from the axis toward the far end)... STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_conn_u1
params.label: Connectors to
params.doc: ... to here. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_conn_w
params.label: Connector block width
params.doc: The connector block across the case. STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_conn_h
params.label: Connector block height
params.doc: How far the block stands off the back face (its pins 1.7 more). STS3215 from The Robot Studio's SO-ARM100 CAD (STEP/SO100/STS3215_03a.step, Apache-2.0), measured with OCCT.

params.name: sts_plug_len
params.label: Cable plug keep-out
params.doc: Room behind the connectors for the plugs and the bend of the bus cable (checked clear of every part): the cable leaves the back of the servo, away from the base, to the bus adapter.

groups.name: Top plate (Base 9; Base 15: a cap on the base's four posts)

params.name: top_t
params.label: Top plate thickness
params.doc: Base 9: the flat plate over the handle-gears, fingers and pinion. Base 15: a plain cap on the base's four posts (sockets over the pivot posts, M3 down into the pillars). Prints top face down.

params.name: top_bush_r
params.label: Top plate radius round each pivot
params.doc: Base 21 reduced support footprint; actual axle capture and M3 clearance checked in geometry_checks.json.

params.name: top_gap
params.label: Gap under the top plate
params.doc: Base 9: running clearance between the top plate and the handle-gears, fingers and pinion under it. It is all that keeps them from lifting: they are captured top and bottom.

params.name: pillar_d
params.label: Top plate pillar
params.doc: Base 21 reduced support footprint; actual axle capture and M3 clearance checked in geometry_checks.json.

params.name: pillar_rim
params.label: Plate rim round a pillar
params.doc: Base 21 reduced support footprint; actual axle capture and M3 clearance checked in geometry_checks.json.

params.name: pillar_x
params.label: Pillars across
params.doc: Base 12: the two pillars the top plate stands on sit this far either side of the centreline, at the base's lower corners (Base 11 had a third pillar on a tab between the fingers; gone, to keep the gripping area clear).

params.name: pillar_z
params.label: Pillars down
params.doc: Base 12: the pillars' height along the fingers from the pivots' line (negative: below it), clear of the handle-gears' teeth at every swing and of the pinion.

params.name: cap_socket
params.label: Cap socket depth
params.doc: Base 15: how deep each pivot post's tip runs up into a blind socket in the top plate's underside. The sockets hold the axles' top ends and locate the cap on the base.

params.name: cap_fit
params.label: Cap socket fit
params.doc: Base 15: each post socket over its post, each side, and how far short of the socket's floor the post's tip stops.

params.name: pillar_floor
params.label: Pillar screw floor
params.doc: Base 15: the pilot down each pillar stops this far above the base's top face (blind).

params.name: pillar_pilot_d
params.label: Pillar screw pilot
params.doc: Base 15: the hole down each pillar the cap's M3 cuts its own thread in (blind, pillar_floor over the base).

params.name: top_access_clear
params.label: Pinion screw access clearance
params.doc: Base 9: the top plate's hole over the pinion clears its 3 flange screw heads by this much, so the pinion comes off with the plate on.

groups.name: Wrist interface (Base 10): hub on the arm, tool plate on each tool

params.name: hub_d
params.label: Hub diameter
params.doc: Base 10: the wrist hub, a disc bolted to the B601-RS J6 output (an RS00, the same flange as our motor: motor_out_pcd). Seeed's aluminium "Gripper Connector A" (2-M6-ROTOR.step) is 35.6; this printed one is its twin, so either fits every tool plate.

params.name: hub_t
params.label: Hub thickness
params.doc: Base 10: Connector A is 6 thick. It sits on J6's 1 mm output boss (its arm face is the boss top, link6 z 0 in Seeed's URDF).

params.name: hub_bore_d
params.label: Hub centre bore
params.doc: Base 10: the centre hole (Connector A: 14).

params.name: hub_screws
params.label: Hub screws to J6
params.doc: Base 10: how many of the J6 output's motor_out_holes the hub is bolted through (Connector A: 4; the printed hub takes all 6). Must divide motor_out_holes.

params.name: hub_screw_phase_deg
params.label: Hub screw angle
params.doc: Base 10: the first J6 screw's angle from +x. J6 turns anyway, so only the hub's own features care.

params.name: hub_cbore_d
params.label: Hub screw counterbore
params.doc: Base 10: M3 socket heads sit in these, from the hub's tool face (Connector A: 6.0).

params.name: hub_cbore_h
params.label: Hub counterbore depth
params.doc: Base 10: depth of those counterbores; the rest is the screw grip (M3 x 6: 3 grip + 3 into J6's 5 deep holes).

params.name: hub_relief_d
params.label: Hub relief holes
params.doc: Base 10: 3 holes on 24.46 that clear the RS00 output's 3 x 3 mm features (Connector A: 4.0). 0 = none.

params.name: hub_relief_pcd
params.label: Hub relief circle
params.doc: Base 10: the RS00 drawing's 24.46 circle.

params.name: hub_scallop_d
params.label: Hub scallops
params.doc: Base 10: 4 notches round the hub's edge on the tool screws' circle (motor_back_pcd, 45 deg) clear those screws' heads, which stand in the tool plate's bore (Connector A: 7.06).

params.name: radial_n
params.label: Radial screws
params.doc: Base 10: how a tool locks onto the hub: M3 screws in from the tool plate's side into the hub's rim, as Seeed's stock gripper does (Connector B to A: 3 at 120 deg). Loosen 3 screws, lift the tool off, slide the next one on.

params.name: radial_phase_deg
params.label: Radial screw angle
params.doc: Base 10: the first radial screw's angle from +x (Connector A: 30, 150, 270). Kept 45 deg off the tool screws, and the Aero plate's cable channel sits between two of them.

params.name: radial_pilot_d
params.label: Radial pilot (hub)
params.doc: Base 10: the printed hub's radial holes; the M3 cuts its own thread (Connector A is tapped M3).

params.name: radial_pilot_len
params.label: Radial pilot depth
params.doc: Base 10: how deep they run in from the hub's rim.

params.name: tool_d
params.label: Tool plate diameter
params.doc: Base 10: the tool plate, every tool's side of the interface: the twin of Seeed's "Gripper Connector B" (2-M7-STATOR.step, 56.8), the RS00's own diameter.

params.name: tool_t
params.label: Tool plate thickness
params.doc: Base 10: Connector B: 9.5, of which tool_floor is the floor and the rest the socket the hub drops into.

params.name: tool_floor
params.label: Tool plate floor
params.doc: Base 10: the floor between the socket and the tool (Connector B: 3). The hub's tool face seats on it.

params.name: tool_bore_d
params.label: Socket bore
params.doc: Base 10: the socket for the hub (Connector B: 36.0, so the 35.6 hub has 0.2 a side).

params.name: tool_center_d
params.label: Tool plate centre hole
params.doc: Base 10: the floor's centre hole (Connector B: 26.2).

params.name: tool_screw_pcd
params.label: Tool screw circle
params.doc: Base 10: 4 x M3 on 38 at 45 deg, through the floor into the tool. The RS00's back face has exactly this (motor_back_pcd), and so does the Aero Hand's wrist pad (4 M3 inserts on a 26.9 square, measured from its CAD): one tool plate fits both.

params.name: tool_screw_phase_deg
params.label: Tool screw angle
params.doc: Base 10: the first tool screw's angle (Connector B: 45).

params.name: tool_head_d
params.label: Tool screw head pocket
params.doc: Base 10: the 4 tool screws' heads stand on the floor in pockets half in the socket wall (Connector B: 6.2, 3.5 high); the hub's scallops clear them. Printed, each pocket runs on up to the socket's mouth, so nothing hangs over it.

params.name: radial_h
params.label: Radial screw height
params.doc: Base 10: the radial screws' axis above the floor top: the hub's mid-thickness (Connector B: 3).

params.name: radial_clear_d
params.label: Radial clearance hole
params.doc: Base 10: the radial screws' clearance in the tool plate (Connector B: 3.5).

params.name: radial_head_d
params.label: Radial screw head counterbore
params.doc: Base 10: counterbore for the radial screws' heads, from the rim in to radial_seat_r (Connector B: 5.8).

params.name: radial_seat_r
params.label: Radial head seat
params.doc: Base 10: the heads seat this far from the axis (Connector B: spot faces at 21.9), so M3 x 8 reaches 4 mm into the hub.

groups.name: Wrist bracket (Base 10, Base 14 on the STS3215): gripper to tool plate

params.name: mount_axis_y
params.label: J6 axis offset (dorsal)
params.doc: Base 10: where the arm's roll axis (J6) runs, along the fingers (Z), dorsal of the finger mid-plane. 0: through the fingers' mid-plane and between the fingers, as the stock gripper's fingers are, so rolling the wrist turns the fingers about their own centre line. -30 puts it nearer the motor (the centre of mass) and shortens the bracket.

params.name: mount_gap
params.label: Gap under the gripper
params.doc: Base 10: clearance between the bracket's foot and the gripper's lowest part (Base 14: the base's wrist tab).

params.name: foot_t
params.label: Foot thickness
params.doc: Base 10: the bracket's foot, the flat plate across the J6 axis that the tool plate screws to. It carries the gripper ~70 mm out from the leg (mount_axis_y 0), so it is thick: 8.

params.name: foot_pilot_d
params.label: Foot pilot holes
params.doc: Base 10: the 4 tool screws come up through the tool plate's floor into these (self-tapped, right through the foot: M3 x 10 = 3 floor + 7).

params.name: leg_t
params.label: Leg thickness
params.doc: Base 10: the bracket's leg, a plate up the motor's back face, bolted to its 4 M3 (motor_back_pcd); M3 x 8 = 5 + 3 of the 4 mm thread. Base 14: the leg lies flat under the base's wrist tab instead; M3 x 10 = 5 through the leg + 5 into the 6 mm tab.

params.name: leg_boss_r
params.label: Leg rim round each screw
params.doc: Base 10: the leg is the hull of a disc this big round each leg screw and the foot. Base 14: the base's wrist tab is the same discs.

params.name: gusset_t
params.label: Gusset thickness
params.doc: Base 10: two ribs between leg and foot, on the leg's outer side at its edges.

params.name: gusset_len
params.label: Gusset size
params.doc: Base 10: each gusset's legs (a 45 deg triangle, so it prints without support). Base 14: 10 (Base 10: 15), so the gussets stay under the servo's near end.

params.name: wrist_screw_x
params.label: Wrist tab screws across
params.doc: Base 14: the two M3 that clamp the bracket's leg under the base's wrist tab sit this far either side of the centreline. The STS3215's back face has no screw ring (Base 10's leg bolted to the RS00's), so the base takes the arm's load, not the servo case.

params.name: wrist_screw_z
params.label: Wrist tab screws height
params.doc: Base 14: their height along the fingers from the pivots' line (negative: below it). -56 puts the tab (leg_boss_r round each) 2 mm under the servo's near end and just under the base's disc round the pinion, so the leg lies flat under the base beside the servo, never on it.

params.name: wrist_pilot_d
params.label: Wrist tab pilot hole
params.doc: Base 14: the tab's holes, straight through the base (vertical as it prints); the M3 cut their own thread.

params.name: gusset_x
params.label: Gussets across
params.doc: Base 14: the two gussets sit this far either side of the centreline, inboard of the leg screws so their heads and the hex key stay clear (Base 10 put them at the leg's edges).

params.name: tie_x
params.label: Cable tie x
params.doc: Base 10: the motor cable is zip-tied to the foot here, then drops past the tool plate to J6, as the stock gripper's does. Base 14: 5 (Base 10: 30), under the STS3215's bus connectors.

params.name: tie_dy
params.label: Cable tie y (from the motor back)
params.doc: Base 10: the tie point's y, measured in from the motor's back face (Base 14: the STS3215's back face).

params.name: tie_gap
params.label: Tie slot spacing
params.doc: Base 10: the two zip-tie slots straddle the cable this far apart (centre to centre).

params.name: tie_w
params.label: Tie slot length
params.doc: Base 10: each slot's long side (a 3.6 mm zip tie).

params.name: tie_slot_t
params.label: Tie slot width
params.doc: Base 10: each slot's short side.

params.name: aero_spacer
params.label: Aero plate spacer
params.doc: Base 10: the Aero Hand's tool plate is a tool plate plus this much more below the floor, so the hand's USB and 6 V leads leave its wrist pad's 15 mm centre hole sideways in a channel instead of being pinched by the 3 mm floor. M3 x 14: 3 floor + 8 spacer + 3 into the hand's inserts.

params.name: aero_channel_w
params.label: Cable channel width
params.doc: Base 10: the channel in the plate's hand face, from the centre to the rim.

params.name: aero_channel_h
params.label: Cable channel depth
params.doc: Base 10: its straight walls' height; the roof above them peaks at 45 deg (aero_channel_w/2 higher), so it prints open side down without support. Walls + roof must stay inside the spacer and floor.

params.name: aero_channel_deg
params.label: Cable channel direction
params.doc: Base 10: from +x; kept between two radial screws and clear of the four tool screws.

params.name: arm_roll_deg
params.label: Wrist roll shown
params.doc: Base 10: the reBot Arm's J6 roll in the preview (arm_pose.py, at export; not live).

params.name: aero_view_x
params.label: Aero Hand shown at x
params.doc: Base 10: in the preview the Aero Hand and its plate stand beside the arm, as the other tool on the rack.

params.name: mm_per_px
params.doc: Photo scale: ~110 mm pivot to tip. No measured scale.

params.name: px_pivot
params.doc: Frame origin in the two-hands photo.

params.name: axis_deg
params.doc: Bisector of the two closed fingers in the photo (27 and 46 deg).

params.name: contact_back
params.doc: Base 12: -0.017. How far the smoothed point sits outboard of the traced one; sets the toe-in (gripper.scad toe) so closed the points meet with no overlap. Toed in, the solid meets 0.6 mm behind the traced point, where the rounding sits 0.019 mm further out than at the point; -0.017 leaves ~0.002 mm per side, inside the 0.01 mm push of the contact checks. (2.5-Base 11: 0.0005, which set the pivot spacing.)

params.name: rail_p
params.doc: Two outer-edge points of the traced outline where the edge is straight within 0.3 mm (the handle's rail).

params.name: round_back
params.doc: How far tip_r rounds the triangle point back from the trace (trace_photo.py ROUND_BACK).

params.name: max_angle
params.doc: Each finger's largest swing about its pivot.

params.name: drive_gap
params.label: Gear to finger clearance
params.doc: Axial air gap between the 6 mm Gripper 24 band and the inverted overhead gear teeth. Adds to overall depth; CAD motion only, physical hand clearance unverified.

params.name: key_r
params.label: Hex boss radius
params.doc: Circumradius of short integral finger-to-gear hex boss; 3 mm post with 0.25 mm radial bore clearance, minimum hex wall about 1.1 mm.

params.name: key_fit
params.label: Hex radial allowance
params.doc: Radial socket offset; resin fit requires physical calibration.

params.name: key_depth
params.label: Hex engagement
params.doc: Boss engagement inside the overhead gear, captured axially by base and cap.

params.name: key_end_gap
params.label: Hex tip clearance
params.doc: Boss tip clearance in gear socket; cap limits axial travel.

params.name: tool_d
params.label: Driver shaft envelope
params.doc: Straight 2.5 mm shaft probe for small screw drivers; handle outside assembly, not an L-key swing proof.

params.name: tool_len
params.label: Driver access length
params.doc: Axial shaft access outside stack; assemble servo and purchased plate first.

params.name: case_tool_tilt
params.label: Near ear driver tilt
params.doc: Near ear screws need 10 degree PH0 shaft tilt away from motor output-end overhang. Straight driver is blocked; physical screw-drive engagement at this angle unverified.

params.name: contact_edge_w
params.label: Direct outside edge
params.doc: Trim the retired strap-hook protrusions back to the original straight outside rail, for direct thumb/index contact.

params.name: contact_trim_u0
params.label: Hook trim start
params.doc: Extent along original rail including lower hook.

params.name: contact_trim_u1
params.label: Hook trim end
params.doc: Extent along original rail including upper hook; distal working blade preserved.

params.name: compact_cap
params.label: Four-post cap
params.doc: Hull only the two pivot sockets and two fastening pillars; remove inherited pinion disc and access opening.

params.name: cap_rear_z
params.label: Rear cap support position
params.doc: Rear pillar Z coordinate; closer to pivots without entering pinion motion. Revalidate full stroke after tuning.
